title: Preparation-equivalence no-go for nonlinear PDT state updates
proved: Operational preparation equivalence forces deterministic state updates Phi_R to be affine on the convex state space.
If the affine update is CPTP, it is operationally an ordinary quantum channel rather than a new probability calculus.
The candidate N(rho)=rho^2/Tr(rho^2) is preparation-context dependent; for rho=diag(3/4,1/4), direct application yields diag(9/10,1/10) while ensemble-wise application yields diag(3/4,1/4).
falsified: A genuinely nonlinear deterministic PDT pre-measurement map can preserve unrestricted preparation equivalence and standard no-signalling semantics while yielding a same-input deviation.
prior_art_boundary: Simon, Buzek & Gisin, Phys. Rev. Lett. 87, 170405 (2001), DOI 10.1103/PhysRevLett.87.170405
open_after_cycle: PDT-native composition law beyond known operator-sector bookkeeping
same-input deviation based on a genuinely new physical variable/interaction rather than nonlinear relabeling
gravity/capacity law only if independently derivable
